name: Sunshine Insurance Group Company Limited
summary: Sunshine Insurance Group Company Limited provides various insurance products and related services in the People's Republic of China. It operates through three segments: Life Insurance, Property and Casualty Insurance, and Other Businesses segments. The company offers life, health, and accident insurance products; property and casualty insurance products comprising automobile, accident, short-term health, guarantee, liability, agriculture, cargo, and commercial property insurance products. It also provides credit and guarantee insurance, and asset management services.
